text:
maria: Heads-up — last weekend APAC shoulder saw weird token pressure. Can we sanity-check headroom for Saturday 09:00 JST? Looking at warmup churn and small requests.

kevin: Which cluster/zone? ap-northeast-1 or ap-southeast-1?

maria: ap-northeast-1 primary, fallback to ap-southeast if overloaded. Baseline weekend qps ~130, but saw spikes to 210 for short bursts. Avg token/sec per GPU measured ~28k -> seemed low.

kai: I ran a quick sensitivity sweep. Pasting results.

kai: ```bash
./sim-headroom --region=ap-northeast-1 --window=10m --burst=210 --base-qps=130 --model=redwood-3b-q8
# outputs (summary)
concurrent_reqs_peak: 420
tokens_sec_peak: 250000
gpu_headroom_pct: 11.2
est_gpu_hours_overnight: +9.4%
fallback_to_ap-southeast1 triggered at 92% util
```

saurabh: 11% headroom is tight. For safety we want >=25% for shoulder. Options: bump reserved GPUs by 1 slab (~+18% capacity), or enable more aggressive prefix caching and reduce kv_cache_ttl to 45s.

kevin: Cost delta for +1 slab? ~$6k/mo on Dedicated, but reduces p99 latency violations. We can also use transient burst pool if we accept slightly higher egress.

maria: Can we get a quick what-if for enabling prefix cache & lighter quant? If caching reduces tokens/sec by 12% we get headroom ~23%

kai: Ran another sim with cache enabled and q4 quant profile:

kai: ```json
{"scenario":"cache_on_q4","tokens_sec_peak":220000,"gpu_headroom_pct":"22.7","gpu_hours_delta":"+3.1%"}
```

ops-bot: Metric snapshot @2101112223: ap-northeast-1/gpu-pool-3 util=87% p95_latency=78ms export: https://grafana/redwood/d/apac?from=2101112000&to=2101112300

maria: Nice. Preference is soft config changes first — enable prefix cache + increase cache TTL, then monitor. If p95 > 200ms we fallback to +1 slab. I'll file a PR for runtime flags.

kevin: I'll reserve one slab on standby (no commit) and keep it cold until we see sustained >90% for 15m.

saurabh: Also flag to Cost: projected +$2.1k monthly if we shift to cache+burst (transit egress), vs +$6k for slab. I'll ping finance.

maria: :thumbsup: plan sounds good. Can someone add a short smoke test for weekend run at 09:00 JST?

kai: I'll schedule a canary at 08:40 JST that simulates 200 qps ramp over 5m.

maria: Thanks — keeping thread open for updates. /cc @kevin @kai @saurabh ops-bot
